sections.Profile:
"Virginia" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Manufacturing Company on March 30, 1948. Designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin, the game features six flippers, ten passive bumpers, and two kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
